Messages.Author: Bernard M. Bresnahan
Messages.Body:
Is it conceivable that you will be coming out with a V:tES 2nd edition?

It would be in line with many other role playing systems that release
new editions to make corrections and clarifications.

Granted we just switched from "Jyhad" to "V:tES", but it would make a
lot of these arguements much easier if cards were redone with the text
fixed (obviously as many cards in V:tES still aren't very clear or are
still poorly written).

IMHO, that should be the forum where cards like "Blythe Candelaria"
gets "fixed". In our group (about 25 people) we play by the text on the
cards unless something was "fixed" textually in the V:tES release. It
also wouldn't hurt to redo the rules book a bit (kill the basic game,
the strategy element of Jyhad is still much easier to learn that "Third
Reich" (tm) or "Star Fleet Battles" <tm>).

So tell me, is there anything possibly in the works for something like
this after The Sabbat? Or are some of the cards discussed here being
released as "fixed" versions in the Sabbat release?

Thanks much,

Ber...@izzy.net
Convention Chair
Gamers of Eastern Michigan University

http://www.izzy.net/~bernie

Messages.Author: World Telecom. 735-0408
Messages.Body:
Bernard M. Bresnahan (ber...@izzy.net) wrote:
: Is it conceivable that you will be coming out with a V:tES 2nd edition?

I for one am disappointed that they didn't take the opportunity to
at least give a revised, corrected rulebook with the new Sabbat expansion.
If it really is a stand-alone expansion, it should have been sold in the
starter (w/revised rulebook) as well as boosters, the same as is done
for the Ice Age and Mirage stand-alones for Magic. I'm not too impressed
with the jumbo-pack plus rules addition format that they came up with
instead.

I hope at the very least that as V:tES is printed accrding to
demand, that cards with mistakes on them will be fixed.

--
Jeremy (bea...@owt.com)
